1.consolidated_definition: ‘Estar una cosa perfectamente hecha.’ Maura. “Me impaciento pero en medio de toda esta tribulación entiendo que debo funcionar por el libro.” Juan Antonio Ramos, Vive y vacila, p. 54.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To be perfectly made or done; to be in a state of completion.

Note: The term "tribulación" is translated as "tribulation", which refers to a state of great difficulty or suffering, but also has connotations of spiritual struggle, particularly in the context of Puerto Rican culture.
